name: coin-vault
description: Coin Vault - virtual currency platform for a gaming store (Express + Prisma/PostgreSQL API, Next.js web)

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
